affected_system: urban water supply, distribution, and conservation system
alternatives: compare phased eligible and not-yet-treated accounts
separate price, rebate, and technical-assistance components
estimate demand and affordability effects by baseline use group
assumptions: Supply, demand, leakage, and storage balances use reconciled units and meter coverage.
Restriction response and climate sequences are observed inputs or labeled scenarios.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: Eligible accounts retain the pre-program tariff and assistance conditions.

constraints.description: Essential-use floors, affordability, treatment timing, and heterogeneous effects must be pre-specified.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: water utility general manager and drought-response lead
decision_question: Did a phased conservation incentive reduce discretionary demand without burdening essential use?

independence_key.binding_constraint: Essential-use floors, affordability, treatment timing, and heterogeneous effects must be pre-specified.
independence_key.decision_object: phased water-conservation pricing and assistance program
independence_key.evidence_gate: Dated eligibility, meter panels, comparable accounts, pre-trends, weather controls, spillovers, and billing changes are verified.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: staggered policy causal evaluation with meter panels
independence_key.primary_outcome: change in weather-normalized discretionary water demand

intended_claim: A versioned evaluate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting phased water-conservation pricing and assistance program, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: change in weather-normalized discretionary water demand
distributional gap in change in weather-normalized discretionary water demand
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not infer welfare gains from lower consumption or causal effects from simple before-after billing totals.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Dated eligibility, meter panels, comparable accounts, pre-trends, weather controls, spillovers, and billing changes are verified.

title: Evaluate conservation pricing and assistance effects
transportability_risks: Water rights, source portfolios, pricing, metering, leakage, and climate regimes differ.
Household conservation behavior may not transfer across tariff and tenure systems.
